prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original panoramic website hero and scenic backdrop for Magpie, an independent fantasy survival server journal. Primary request: premium cinematic fantasy woodland key art, tactile painterly 3D realism, polished art direction and exquisite material detail. Scene: an ancient forest valley at blue hour, layers of pine-covered crags and a narrow silver-teal river winding toward a distant amber sunset, mossy broken standing stones, ferns and fine grasses in the foreground, a few firefly sparks. Main subject: a beautiful anatomically convincing Eurasian magpie with long blue-green iridescent tail, glossy black head and white shoulder and belly, perched on a weathered moss-covered stone at the RIGHT THIRD of the image, head turned slightly left, lit by a small warm brass lantern resting below it. The bird should be clearly readable and fairly large, approximately one third of image height, with beautifully detailed feathers. Composition: widescreen landscape 16:9, 2560x1440 if possible; quiet darker atmospheric negative space across the LEFT HALF for HTML heading and readable copy; hero bird and lantern stay in right third; foreground cliff along lower edge; distant landscape fills middle. Lighting: cool moonlit teal and ink-blue, soft violet distant mist, warm champagne-gold sunset and lantern, natural volumetric light, rich but restrained contrast. Palette: midnight navy #101522, deep evergreen, aged pale gold #e3b34c, ivory. Constraints: original art only, no specific game characters, no game logos, no extracted textures, no interface, no text, no letters, no watermark, no decorative borders. Avoid simplistic flat vector shapes, cartoon eyes, excessive magical sparkles, excessive saturation. The result should feel like a beautifully crafted fantasy game art book landscape, welcoming and mysterious.
